summary.paragraph: Backend-focused Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience building APIs, web systems and mobile apps with Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript and .NET. I own each project from requirements gathering with the client to production deployment.

I am currently the sole developer of the logistics ERP for Ambiental Cord S.R.L. at LogixARG: I make the technical decisions, refine requirements with the client alongside the Product Owner and ship working features to production every sprint. I work with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Docker and CI/CD, applying Clean Architecture, TDD and agile practices, and I use AI agents (Claude Code, Codex) to speed up development without compromising quality.

work.name: Full Stack Developer
work.summary: Custom software development for businesses, from requirements gathering to production deployment.
achievements: Sole developer of the logistics ERP for Ambiental Cord S.R.L. (used cooking oil collection), now in production. It replaced Excel spreadsheets and most manual work, significantly reduced administrative time and improved control over every collection.
Defined the architecture and technical decisions: a NestJS and TypeScript API on PostgreSQL (Supabase), a React admin panel and a React Native (Expo) mobile app for drivers with offline mode.
Built the route sheet, fleet, preventive maintenance, manifest, PDF/Excel reporting and WhatsApp notification modules, with role-based JWT authentication and ControlSat GPS integration.

Refine requirements directly with the client alongside the Product Owner, ship working features to production every sprint, and review and merge UI changes from another developer into the main branch.
Ensure quality through TDD (Jest, unit and integration tests), CI/CD with GitHub Actions and Vercel, and deployment with Docker Compose and Nginx.

Brought AI agents (Claude Code and Codex) into the development workflow to generate code, tests and documentation, always validated through code review and CI. This lets me single-handedly maintain a system of this size with higher test coverage.

Built a WhatsApp chatbot with the Anthropic API (Claude Haiku) that answers inquiries, qualifies leads and books meetings, integrated with LogixARG's sales back office (lead and pipeline CRM). Also built the corporate landing page.

Backend in .NET with C# and Entity Framework, and frontend in Angular.

work.name: Software Developer
work.summary: Software factory. Started with code reviews, then took on development tasks and was finally assigned to a project, contributing to backend, frontend and documentation.
achievements: Developed and maintained REST APIs with .NET and C#, applying Clean Architecture, design patterns and testing.
Built Angular interfaces, designed databases and wrote SQL queries, working with Scrum.

Final degree project for a real client: backend for the Quilino Municipal Plant Nursery web system with Node.js, Express, TypeScript and PostgreSQL (TypeORM), JWT authentication, Cloudinary image storage and Docker deployment on Railway.
